settings.title: Compare setup and flexibility
settings.text:
Every home gym setup is different, and the right system depends on how you plan to use your space.

Speediance Gym Monster 2 is ideal for flexible environments---perfect for condos, rentals, or multi-use rooms where portability and easy setup matter. Its freestanding, foldable design allows you to train when you want and store it when you don't.

Tonal is well-suited for dedicated workout areas, offering a wall-mounted setup that stays in place and is always ready for use.

settings.heading: One Machine. Every Workout.

settings.title: Chain Mode
settings.subheading: Chain Mode gradually adds more resistance as you reach the top of each rep, matching your natural strength curve. This creates a more challenging finish to every movement and helps build explosive power and strength.

settings.title: Standard Mode
settings.subheading: Standard Mode delivers steady resistance based on your selected weight. It ensures controlled, reliable tension throughout each rep, making it ideal for traditional strength workouts and muscle building.

settings.title: Eccentric Mode
settings.subheading: Eccentric Mode increases resistance as you return to the starting position, emphasizing the negative phase of movement. This helps improve muscle control, increase strength, and maximize training efficiency.

settings.title: Fixed Speed Mode
settings.subheading: Constant Mode maintains a fixed speed or resistance throughout the movement. It's perfect for maintaining a steady pace, improving control, and supporting safer rehabilitation or recovery workouts.

settings.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
settings.question_1: How hard is setup, and do I need to mount it to a wall?
settings.answer_1: No wall mounting or installation is needed. It ships across Canada 95% pre-assembled; just unbox, unfold, and start training in under 10 minutes with no tools required. The unit is freestanding and foldable, making it ideal for condos, rentals, and multi-use rooms.
settings.question_2: Do I need a subscription to use the Gym Monster 2?
settings.answer_2: No. There's a lifetime free basic membership and no mandatory subscription, so you can train without ongoing fees. You can use the machine offline; only online courses require an internet connection.
settings.question_3: Is 220 lbs (100 kg) of digital resistance enough for my goals?
settings.answer_3: For most home users---from beginners to intermediate lifters---it's plenty for full-body strength and functional training, with precise 1 lb/0.5 kg increments and bi-directional loading. Elite heavy lifters (e.g., 400+ lb squats) may still prefer a full power rack typically found in specialized gyms.
settings.question_4: What makes the training "smart," and how does the AI improve safety?
settings.answer_4: An AI "virtual spotter" auto-adjusts resistance in real time to keep reps controlled and safer. The system offers multiple modes (Standard, Chains, Eccentric, Constant, plus Spotter assist), live feedback with 1RM updates and imbalance correction, and sensor-enabled form tracking---then generates post-workout reports to guide progress.
settings.question_5: Which Gym Monster 2 package should I choose?
settings.answer_5: Choose Basic if you already have a quality bench and want the most cost-effective setup. Pick Works Plus if you want a complete standalone strength station with the Adjustable Incline Bench. Go with Family Plus to add the Smart Rowing Bench, turning the system into a combined strength-and-cardio hub.
